cdf_method: nested adaptive quadrature; direct marginal CDF; bg transition splits; no interpolation of discrete posterior atoms
tail_method: global likelihood upper from S>=qo times Gaussian prior outside SF/eps box divided by analytic lower evidence on a small 3D calibration box; interval arithmetic for lower and upper likelihood bounds
evidence_lower_box: center old finite-box posterior mean divided by frozen prior std; halfwidth 0.0001 in each whitened calibration coordinate; center is only a positive-mass integration subset, not new prior
integration_error_claim: QUADPACK error estimates and refinement are numerical evidence, not formal certification of all CDF errors
stop: any mandatory failure keeps REFERENCE_NOT_VALIDATED; no automatic parameter enlargement
legacy_results: preserve all v1 and existing I2 outputs
